description: 7-layer architectural taxonomy of the T81 Foundation platform

layers.name: Language and Development
layers.description: T81Lang source parsing, AST construction, semantic analysis, IR generation, CLI interface, and toolchain bridges.

layers.name: Instruction and Execution
layers.description: TISC instruction set computer contract, bytecode decoding, T81VM deterministic interpreter, round-robin scheduler, and JIT/trace cache.

layers.name: Numerical and Computational Foundations
layers.description: Balanced ternary arithmetic, multi-precision types (T81Limb27/54, T81Int, T81BigInt, T81Fraction), soft math tables, and tensor representations.

layers.name: System Services
layers.description: Axion governance kernel (policy engine, ethics Theta-1..9, nondeterminism detection) and CanonFS immutable content-addressed storage.

layers.name: Operating-System Architecture
layers.description: TernaryOS standalone guest kernel, HAL, GICv3/PL011/VirtIO drivers, page allocation MMU, and DAIOS (RFC-00D2) target architecture.

layers.name: Hardware and Acceleration
layers.description: Physical ternary feasibility research, Verilog RTL models, SIMD AVX2 acceleration primitives, and QEMU hardware emulation.

layers.name: Research and Assurance
layers.description: Empirical hypothesis register H01–H08, SCG continuity evidence receipts, regression suites, determinism registries, and CI gates.
